fact.query: Did the dated repository hold MIT model weights on 2026-06-16?
fact.finding: June 16 repository created, uploads at 08:17–08:18 UTC; snapshot contains 282 safetensors files and model index; June 22 independent chronology distinguishes initial rollout. Model card states MIT. This confirms availability at a dated commit, not successful downstream downloads.

impact.query: Independent documentation of measured production adoption or measurable downstream costs caused by this release?
impact.finding: No observed independently attributed deployment/adoption or baseline-versus-outcome impact in this bounded source set; other reports may exist and were not exhaustively searched.

analysis.query: Independent commentary distinguishing API rollout, published weights, selective model performance and export-policy claims?
analysis.finding: June 22 Nathan Lambert article explicitly distinguishes rollout from open weight publication; author offers commentary and experience, not a controlled GPT-5.5 parity/cost replication or policy-causation proof.

controversy.query: Evidence of independently confirmed concrete dispute about GLM-5.2 weight availability itself?
controversy.finding: No confirmed dispute about the existence of June 16 weight repository in reviewed sources. Disagreement about benchmark comparisons is not recorded as a resolved controversy.
